title: European XFEL X 光自由電子雷射~European XFEL
focus: 突發模式超導直線加速、可變間隙 SASE 波盪器、掠射 X 光光學與 MHz 偵測器的系統工程~Systems engineering of burst-mode superconducting acceleration, variable-gap SASE undulators, grazing-incidence X-ray optics and MHz detectors
summary: 從 European XFEL 的 3.4 km 超導直線加速器與每秒 10 列、每列最多 2700 發的突發模式出發，理解射頻脈衝預算、波盪器共振與段間相位、2 K 低溫負載、掠射反射鏡面形、AGIPD 記憶格校正、束團分配與機器保護如何串成一座可交接的硬 X 光雷射設施。~Starting from the 3.4 km superconducting linac of European XFEL and its burst mode of 10 trains per second with up to 2700 pulses each, see how the RF pulse budget, undulator resonance and inter-segment phase, 2 K cryogenic load, grazing-mirror figure, AGIPD memory-cell calibration, bunch distribution and machine protection combine into a hard X-ray laser facility that can be handed over.

units.anchor: 1.3 GHz 超導直線加速器與脈衝列~1.3 GHz superconducting linac and pulse train
units.title: 突發模式超導加速與射頻脈衝預算~Burst-mode superconducting acceleration and the RF pulse budget
units.mechanism: European XFEL 全長 3.4 km，從漢堡 DESY 延伸到 Schenefeld；其中 2.1 km 的加速器以 1.3 GHz TESLA 型鈮超導腔在約 2 K 運轉。超導腔壁的表面電阻極低，射頻能量幾乎不在腔壁耗散，因此可以使用約 1.5 ms 的長射頻脈衝，每秒 10 列，每列以 4.5 MHz（間隔約 222 ns）放入最多 2700 個電子束團，合計每秒最多 27,000 發 X 光脈衝。列與列之間約 99.4 ms 的空檔留給低溫系統、偵測器讀出與機器保護恢復。這種突發模式與每秒百餘發的常溫銅腔或連續波機器是完全不同的系統邊界。~European XFEL is 3.4 km long, running from DESY in Hamburg to Schenefeld; its 2.1 km accelerator uses 1.3 GHz TESLA-type niobium superconducting cavities at about 2 K. Because the superconducting wall resistance is tiny, almost no RF energy is dissipated in the walls, so RF pulses of about 1.5 ms are possible: 10 trains per second, each holding up to 2700 electron bunches at 4.5 MHz (about 222 ns apart), for up to 27,000 X-ray pulses per second. The roughly 99.4 ms gap between trains lets the cryogenics, detector readout and machine protection recover. This burst mode is a completely different system boundary from a copper linac firing about a hundred pulses per second or a continuous-wave machine.
units.model: 腔體場的時間常數 τ = Q_L/(π·f₀)；假設負載 Q_L ≈ 4.6×10⁶、f₀ = 1.3 GHz，τ ≈ 1.13 ms，以先強後穩的充填策略約需 τ·ln2 ≈ 0.78 ms 到達平頂。2700 個束團 × 222 ns ≈ 0.60 ms 的平頂加上充填共約 1.38 ms，落在約 1.5 ms 的速調管脈衝之內；每秒脈衝數為 10 × 2700 = 27,000。~The cavity field time constant is τ = Q_L/(π·f₀); assuming a loaded Q_L ≈ 4.6×10⁶ and f₀ = 1.3 GHz, τ ≈ 1.13 ms, and a boosted fill reaches flat top after about τ·ln2 ≈ 0.78 ms. A flat top of 2700 bunches × 222 ns ≈ 0.60 ms plus the fill totals about 1.38 ms, inside the roughly 1.5 ms klystron pulse; pulses per second are 10 × 2700 = 27,000.
units.verify: 用低階射頻（LLRF）系統記錄每個射頻站的前向波、反射波與腔內探針波形，確認充填段、平頂段與衰減段的時間與上式一致；再以束流電荷監測器與束流位置監測器逐束團記錄電荷與軌跡，確認 2700 個位置都落在平頂內，且平頂幅度與相位的漂移在規格內。~Record forward, reflected and cavity-probe waveforms of every RF station with the low-level RF (LLRF) system and confirm that fill, flat-top and decay timings agree with the relation above; then log charge and orbit bunch by bunch with charge monitors and beam-position monitors to confirm that all 2700 slots sit on the flat top and that amplitude and phase drift along the flat top stay within specification.
units.failure: 若負載 Q 設錯或腔體失諧，充填時間變長、平頂縮短，列尾束團在場強下降處被加速而能量偏低，波盪器共振波長跟著偏移，脈衝列後段失去雷射增益；使用者只在列的前段看到 X 光，卻常被誤判為波盪器或光學問題。~With a wrong loaded Q or a detuned cavity, the fill lengthens and the flat top shrinks; bunches at the end of the train are accelerated on a falling field and arrive low in energy, their undulator resonance shifts and the tail of the train loses lasing. Users see X-rays only at the start of the train, which is often misdiagnosed as an undulator or optics problem.
units.misconception: 超導腔沒有損耗，所以脈衝列可以任意加長，只受電子槍限制。~Superconducting cavities are lossless, so the train can be made arbitrarily long and only the gun limits it.

units.anchor: 可變間隙波盪器共振~Variable-gap undulator resonance
units.title: 波盪器共振、K 值與光子能量覆蓋~Undulator resonance, K parameter and photon-energy coverage
units.mechanism: 電子在週期 λu 的交替磁場中蛇行，在電子座標中看到被勞侖茲收縮的磁場週期，發出的輻射再經都卜勒壓縮回實驗室，因此共振波長為 λ = λu/(2γ²)·(1 + K²/2)，K = 0.934·B[T]·λu[cm]。European XFEL 的 SASE1 與 SASE2 為 175 m 長的可變間隙波盪器，涵蓋約 3 keV 到 25 keV 以上；SASE3 長 105 m，涵蓋 0.26 到 3 keV。改變磁鐵間隙就改變 B 與 K，因此電子能量固定時各波盪器仍可獨立調整光子能量，這是多條光束線同時服務使用者的物理基礎。SASE 從電子的散粒雜訊起振，單程通過中指數放大並在飽和前形成微束團。~Electrons wiggle through an alternating field of period λu; in their own frame they see a Lorentz-contracted period, and the emitted radiation is Doppler-compressed back into the laboratory, giving the resonant wavelength λ = λu/(2γ²)·(1 + K²/2) with K = 0.934·B[T]·λu[cm]. At European XFEL, SASE1 and SASE2 are 175 m variable-gap undulators covering about 3 keV to beyond 25 keV, and SASE3 is 105 m long covering 0.26 to 3 keV. Opening or closing the magnet gap changes B and K, so each undulator tunes its photon energy independently at a fixed electron energy, which is the physical basis for serving several beamlines at once. SASE starts from electron shot noise, amplifies exponentially in a single pass and microbunches the beam before saturation.
units.model: 以電子能量 14 GeV（γ ≈ 27,397）、SASE1 週期 λu = 40 mm、K = 2.5 為例：λ = 0.040/(2×27,397²)×(1 + 3.125) ≈ 0.110 nm，約 11.3 keV；把間隙開大到 K = 1.65 時 λ ≈ 0.063 nm，約 19.7 keV。SASE3 週期 68 mm、K = 4.0 時 λ ≈ 0.41 nm，約 3.0 keV。~Take 14 GeV electrons (γ ≈ 27,397), SASE1 period λu = 40 mm and K = 2.5: λ = 0.040/(2×27,397²)×(1 + 3.125) ≈ 0.110 nm, about 11.3 keV; opening the gap to K = 1.65 gives λ ≈ 0.063 nm, about 19.7 keV. SASE3 with a 68 mm period and K = 4.0 gives λ ≈ 0.41 nm, about 3.0 keV.
units.verify: 由磁量測得到的間隙對 K 曲線計算預期光子能量，再以單發光譜儀或晶體單色器掃描量到的中心能量比對；接著做 K 掃描，確認共振能量隨 1/(1 + K²/2) 變化，並以電子能譜儀量到的束流能量校正 γ，把間隙、K 與光子能量三者的查表一起歸檔。~Compute the expected photon energy from the measured gap-to-K curve and compare it with the centre energy from a single-shot spectrometer or a crystal-monochromator scan; then scan K to confirm that the resonant energy follows 1/(1 + K²/2), calibrate γ against the electron energy from the energy spectrometer, and archive the gap, K and photon-energy tables together.
units.failure: 電子能量讀數若有 0.1% 誤差，因 λ ∝ 1/γ²，光子能量會偏約 0.2%，在 12 keV 約 24 eV，足以讓吸收邊附近的光譜實驗落在錯誤位置；若間隙編碼器零點漂移，則不同光束線之間的能量校正也會互相不一致。~A 0.1% error in the electron-energy reading shifts the photon energy by about 0.2% because λ ∝ 1/γ², about 24 eV at 12 keV, enough to put an absorption-edge spectroscopy experiment in the wrong place; a drifting gap-encoder zero also makes the energy calibration of different beamlines disagree.
units.misconception: 要改變 X 光光子能量就一定得改變電子束能量。~Changing the X-ray photon energy always requires changing the electron energy.

units.anchor: TESLA 九格鈮腔與低溫模組~TESLA nine-cell cavities and cryomodules
units.title: 鈮超導腔、低溫模組與 2 K 熱負載~Niobium cavities, cryomodules and the 2 K heat load
units.mechanism: 主加速器有 96 個低溫模組（注入器另有 2 個，其中一個是 3.9 GHz 三次諧波模組，用來線性化縱向相空間），每個模組裝 8 個 1.3 GHz 九格鈮腔。腔體以高純度鈮板深抽成型、電子束焊接，再經電解拋光、高壓超純水沖洗與無塵室組裝，任何殘留微粒都可能成為場發射源。腔體浸在約 2 K 的超流氦中，Q₀ 可達 10¹⁰，但每瓦在 2 K 移除的熱，在室溫端要付出數百瓦以上的壓縮機功率，因此 Q₀ 與工作比直接決定營運成本。腔體由 E. Zanon 與 Research Instruments 兩家廠商各製作一半，模組在 CEA Saclay 組裝後於 DESY 進行射頻測試。~The main linac has 96 cryomodules (the injector has 2 more, one a 3.9 GHz third-harmonic module that linearises the longitudinal phase space), each holding eight 1.3 GHz nine-cell niobium cavities. Cavities are deep-drawn from high-purity niobium sheet, electron-beam welded, electropolished, rinsed with high-pressure ultrapure water and assembled in a clean room; any residual particle can become a field-emission site. Immersed in superfluid helium near 2 K they reach Q₀ of 10¹⁰, yet every watt removed at 2 K costs hundreds of watts or more of compressor power at room temperature, so Q₀ and duty factor set operating cost directly. Production was split between E. Zanon and Research Instruments, and modules were assembled at CEA Saclay before RF testing at DESY.
units.model: 能量增益 ≈ N·L_act·E_acc（同相加速的教學估算）：768 腔 × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV。動態熱負載 P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀)：V = 23.6 MV/m × 1.0377 m ≈ 24.5 MV，R/Q = 1036 Ω，Q₀ = 1×10¹⁰，脈衝內約 58 W；乘上 1.5 ms × 10 Hz = 1.5% 工作比，每腔平均約 0.87 W，768 腔約 670 W（2 K），尚未計入靜態熱漏。~Energy gain ≈ N·L_act·E_acc (on-crest teaching estimate): 768 cavities × 1.0377 m × 22 MV/m ≈ 17.5 GeV. Dynamic load P = V²/((R/Q)·Q₀): V = 23.6 MV/m × 1.0377 m ≈ 24.5 MV, R/Q = 1036 Ω and Q₀ = 1×10¹⁰ give about 58 W during the pulse; with a 1.5 ms × 10 Hz = 1.5% duty factor that is about 0.87 W per cavity and about 670 W at 2 K for 768 cavities, before static losses.
units.verify: 腔體在垂直測試槽中量 Q₀ 對 E_acc 曲線並以輻射偵測器記錄場發射 X 光；模組測試量每腔最大可用梯度、由氦蒸發率推算的動態熱負載與勞侖茲力失諧；安裝後以能譜儀量到的束流能量反推梯度總和，與腔體資料表的加總比對，找出運轉中退化的射頻站。~Measure Q₀ versus E_acc in a vertical test cryostat while logging field-emission X-rays with radiation detectors; in module tests record the maximum usable gradient per cavity, the dynamic load inferred from helium boil-off and the Lorentz-force detuning; after installation back out the summed gradient from the beam energy measured on the spectrometer and compare it with the summed cavity data to find RF stations that degraded in operation.
units.failure: 組裝時帶入的微粒在高場下形成場發射，產生暗電流與輻射、加熱腔體並使 Q₀ 驟降；嚴重時腔體失超，該射頻站只能降梯度運轉，整機最高電子能量下降，而硬 X 光上限隨 γ² 一起下降。~Particles introduced during assembly become field emitters at high field, producing dark current and radiation, heating the cavity and collapsing Q₀; in severe cases the cavity quenches and its RF station must run at reduced gradient, lowering the maximum electron energy and, with γ², the hard X-ray limit.
units.misconception: 超導腔沒有電阻，所以低溫系統只需補償外界熱漏。~Superconducting cavities have no resistance, so the cryoplant only has to cover external heat leaks.

units.anchor: 5 m 波盪器段與移相器~5 m undulator segments and phase shifters
units.title: 波盪器分段、間隙控制與段間相位匹配~Undulator segments, gap control and inter-segment phase matching
units.mechanism: SASE1 與 SASE2 各由 35 段 5 m 長的永久磁鐵波盪器組成，段與段之間留 1.1 m 間隔，放置四極磁鐵、束流位置監測器與相位移相器。每段的間隙由馬達與編碼器控制，微米級的間隙差就會改變 K；磁量測後以墊片修正電子軌跡與相位誤差。電子在無磁場的間隔中相對於光的落後量與在波盪器中不同，若不補償，各段的輻射以錯誤相位疊加，增益長度變長甚至無法飽和。相位移相器是一個小型磁鐵彎道，加長電子路徑使總落後量為波長的整數倍。~SASE1 and SASE2 each consist of 35 permanent-magnet undulator segments 5 m long, separated by 1.1 m intersections that hold a quadrupole, a beam-position monitor and a phase shifter. Each gap is driven by motors with encoders, and a micrometre gap difference already changes K; after magnetic measurement, shims correct the electron trajectory and phase errors. In the field-free intersection the electron falls behind the light by a different amount than inside the undulator, so without compensation the segments radiate with the wrong relative phase, the gain length grows and saturation may never be reached. The phase shifter is a small magnetic chicane that lengthens the electron path so the total slippage is an integer number of wavelengths.
units.model: 忽略段端邊緣場，長 L_d 的自由漂移中電子相對光落後 ΔL = L_d/(2γ²)。取 L_d = 1.1 m、γ = 27,397（14 GeV）：ΔL ≈ 0.733 nm；若 λ = 0.110 nm（K = 2.5），相當於 6.67 個波長，移相器需再補約 0.33λ ≈ 0.037 nm，使總落後為 7λ。光子能量改變時補償量也改變，因此移相器設定必須與 K 值連動查表。~Neglecting segment end fields, an electron in a free drift of length L_d falls behind the light by ΔL = L_d/(2γ²). With L_d = 1.1 m and γ = 27,397 (14 GeV), ΔL ≈ 0.733 nm; for λ = 0.110 nm (K = 2.5) that is 6.67 wavelengths, so the phase shifter adds about 0.33λ ≈ 0.037 nm to make the total slip 7λ. The required delay changes with photon energy, so the shifter setting must be tabulated together with K.
units.verify: 在磁量測台上以霍爾探頭與拉線線圈量每段的 K 值、軌跡與相位誤差均方根，並量移相器的相位積分對間隙曲線；上線後以逐段開啟法量 X 光脈衝能量對段數的增長曲線，並在每個段間掃描移相器，確認脈衝能量的極大值落在查表預測的設定。~On the magnetic bench measure each segment's K, trajectory and RMS phase error with Hall probes and stretched-wire coils, and record the phase-shifter phase integral versus gap; on the machine, measure the gain curve of X-ray pulse energy versus number of closed segments and scan the phase shifter at each intersection, confirming that the pulse-energy maximum lands on the tabulated setting.
units.failure: 某個段間相位錯了半個波長時，下一段的輻射與前段破壞性干涉，增益曲線出現平台或停滯；若換能量後移相器查表沒有跟著 K 更新，脈衝能量大幅掉落，看起來像電子束品質問題而誤導調機方向。~If one intersection is off by half a wavelength, the next segment radiates destructively against the previous one and the gain curve shows a plateau or stall; if the phase-shifter table is not updated with K after an energy change, pulse energy collapses and looks like an electron-beam quality problem, sending tuning in the wrong direction.
units.misconception: 只要每段波盪器的 K 值都調好，段與段之間的間隔不會影響增益。~If every segment has the right K, the gaps between segments cannot affect the gain.

units.anchor: B₄C 鍍膜掠射矽鏡~B₄C-coated grazing silicon mirror
units.title: 掠射反射鏡的臨界角、面形預算與熱凸起~Grazing mirrors: critical angle, figure budget and thermal bumps
units.mechanism: X 光在材料中的折射率為 n = 1 − δ，只有在掠射角小於臨界角 θc ≈ √(2δ) 時才會全外反射，所以 European XFEL 以約 1 m 長、B₄C 鍍膜的矽鏡在數 mrad 的掠射角下導光、偏移與分流。光束在鏡面上的足跡被拉長為 w/θ，因此鏡長要以公尺計；高度誤差 h 在反射時造成 2h·sinθ 的光程差，對 0.1 nm 的波長，奈米級的高度誤差就足以破壞聚焦與同調波前。突發模式在 0.6 ms 內送來數千發脈衝，鏡面局部吸熱形成熱凸起，需要以冷卻設計與幾何最佳化控制。~Inside matter X-rays see n = 1 − δ and are totally externally reflected only below the critical angle θc ≈ √(2δ), so European XFEL steers, offsets and distributes its beams with B₄C-coated silicon mirrors about 1 m long at grazing angles of a few milliradians. The footprint on the mirror stretches to w/θ, which is why the mirrors are metre-scale, and a height error h produces a path difference 2h·sinθ on reflection; at a 0.1 nm wavelength, nanometre height errors already spoil focusing and the coherent wavefront. Burst mode delivers thousands of pulses within 0.6 ms, so local absorption raises a thermal bump that must be managed by cooling design and geometry.
units.model: B₄C（2.52 g/cm³、每分子 26 個電子）在 12 keV（λ ≈ 0.103 nm）時 δ = r_e·λ²·N_e/(2π) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶，θc ≈ 2.6 mrad，24 keV 時降到約 1.3 mrad。取 θ = 2.0 mrad，Maréchal 判準 2h·θ ≤ λ/14 給出 h_rms ≤ λ/(28θ) ≈ 1.8 nm；光束寬 0.8 mm（假設）時足跡為 0.8/0.002 = 400 mm。~For B₄C (2.52 g/cm³, 26 electrons per formula unit) at 12 keV (λ ≈ 0.103 nm), δ = r_e·λ²·N_e/(2π) ≈ 3.4×10⁻⁶ and θc ≈ 2.6 mrad, falling to about 1.3 mrad at 24 keV. At θ = 2.0 mrad the Maréchal condition 2h·θ ≤ λ/14 gives h_rms ≤ λ/(28θ) ≈ 1.8 nm, and an assumed 0.8 mm beam leaves a 0.8/0.002 = 400 mm footprint.
units.verify: 出廠與安裝前以長行程輪廓儀或拼接干涉儀量測鏡面高度與斜率誤差，以功率譜密度分頻段估算對焦斑與同調性的影響；上線後以光柵剪切干涉或刀口掃描量聚焦光斑，並在不同列長下重複，觀察焦點是否隨列內累積熱負載漂移。~Before shipment and installation measure height and slope errors with a long-trace profiler or stitching interferometer and use the power spectral density, band by band, to estimate the effect on focal spot and coherence; on the beamline, measure the focus with grating-based shearing interferometry or knife-edge scans and repeat at several train lengths to see whether the focus drifts with the heat load accumulated during a train.
units.failure: 夾持應力或冷卻管路扭力可以把合格鏡面壓出數奈米的二次曲率，焦點沿光軸偏移；若聚焦光超過鍍膜損傷閾值，B₄C 會剝離，留下散射條紋與不可逆的反射率損失。~Clamping stress or torque from cooling lines can press a few nanometres of quadratic curvature into a passing mirror and move the focus along the axis; if focused light exceeds the coating damage threshold, the B₄C delaminates and leaves scatter streaks and an irreversible reflectance loss.
units.misconception: 掠射角夠小時，X 光反射鏡的面形就不必特別精密。~At a small enough grazing angle the X-ray mirror figure need not be especially precise.

units.anchor: AGIPD 百萬畫素偵測器~AGIPD megapixel detector
units.title: MHz 偵測器：增益切換、記憶格與逐格校正~MHz detectors: gain switching, memory cells and per-cell calibration
units.mechanism: 一般積分型偵測器每秒只讀數十到數百張影像，跟不上 4.5 MHz 的脈衝。AGIPD 在每個 200 µm 畫素下方的讀出晶片內放了 352 個類比記憶格，在脈衝列中以最高 4.5 MHz 逐張存下電荷，再利用列間約 99.4 ms 的空檔讀出並數位化。為了在同一張影像內同時記錄單光子與 12.4 keV 下超過一萬個光子的布拉格峰，每個畫素有高、中、低三段自動增益切換；500 µm 厚的矽感測層決定硬 X 光的吸收效率。代價是每個畫素、每個記憶格、每段增益都有自己的偏移與增益係數。~Ordinary integrating detectors read tens to hundreds of frames per second and cannot follow 4.5 MHz pulses. AGIPD places 352 analogue memory cells in the readout chip beneath every 200 µm pixel, stores charge frame by frame at up to 4.5 MHz during the train, and reads out and digitises during the roughly 99.4 ms gap between trains. To record single photons and Bragg peaks of more than ten thousand 12.4 keV photons in one image, each pixel switches automatically between high, medium and low gain, while the 500 µm silicon sensor sets the hard X-ray absorption efficiency. The price is that every pixel, memory cell and gain stage has its own offset and gain coefficient.
units.model: 1 Mpixel（1024×1024）系統每列最多存 352 張，資料率 ≈ 1,048,576 × 352 × 10 Hz × 2 byte ≈ 7.4 GB/s。校正常數 ≈ 1,048,576 × 352 × 3 段增益 × 2（偏移與增益）≈ 2.2×10⁹ 個。每列 2700 發只能記 352 張，最高利用率 352/2700 ≈ 13%，所以常以較低的列內重複率選發。~A 1 Mpixel (1024×1024) system stores at most 352 frames per train, so the data rate is ≈ 1,048,576 × 352 × 10 Hz × 2 byte ≈ 7.4 GB/s. Calibration needs ≈ 1,048,576 × 352 × 3 gain stages × 2 (offset and gain) ≈ 2.2×10⁹ constants. Only 352 of 2700 pulses per train can be stored, at most 352/2700 ≈ 13%, so a reduced intra-train repetition rate is often selected.
units.verify: 以暗場（無 X 光）量每個記憶格的偏移與雜訊；以晶片內建的脈衝電流源掃描三段增益的切換點與斜率；以已知能量的螢光做平場，用單光子峰把 ADU 換算成光子數；最後以粉末繞射環等標準樣品檢查強度在不同記憶格與增益交界處是否一致。~Take dark frames without X-rays to obtain offset and noise per memory cell; sweep the on-chip pulsed current source to find the switching points and slopes of all three gain stages; flat-field with fluorescence of known energy and convert ADU to photons with the single-photon peak; finally check with a reference sample such as powder-diffraction rings that intensities agree across memory cells and gain boundaries.
units.failure: 若部分記憶格的偏移隨溫度漂移卻沿用舊常數，影像出現隨脈衝序號變化的條紋；增益切換門檻校正不準時，強布拉格峰在增益交界處出現階梯，結構解析的強度資料產生系統偏差。~If some memory-cell offsets drift with temperature while old constants stay in use, images show stripes that change with pulse index; if gain-switch thresholds are miscalibrated, strong Bragg peaks show steps at gain boundaries and structural intensity data become systematically biased.
units.misconception: 每個畫素只要一組偏移與增益常數就能完成校正。~One offset and one gain constant per pixel are enough to calibrate the detector.

units.anchor: 快速踢磁鐵與束團模式~Fast kickers and bunch pattern
units.title: 束團分配、多光束線同時運轉與選發~Bunch distribution, simultaneous beamlines and pulse picking
units.mechanism: 加速器末端以快速踢磁鐵與平頂踢磁鐵把同一列中的束團分到兩條電子束線：一條通往 SASE2，另一條依序通過 SASE1 與 SASE3，SASE3 使用 SASE1 下游的同一批電子。三台波盪器因此共用電子能量，但以各自的間隙設定光子能量；分配切換需要一段時間空檔，各光束線的束團數會互相牽動。實驗站（SPB/SFX、FXE、MID、HED、SQS、SCS）再依偵測器與樣品更新速度選擇列內重複率，不用的束團由踢磁鐵送入束流捕集器。~At the end of the linac, fast and flat-top kickers distribute bunches of the same train into two electron beamlines: one feeds SASE2 and the other passes through SASE1 and then SASE3, which uses the same electrons downstream of SASE1. The three undulators therefore share one electron energy but set their photon energies with their own gaps; switching needs a time gap, so the bunch counts of the beamlines are coupled. Instruments (SPB/SFX, FXE, MID, HED, SQS, SCS) then choose an intra-train repetition rate to suit detector and sample refresh, and unused bunches are kicked into beam dumps.
units.model: 假設分配切換空檔 20 µs（教學假設），每次切換損失 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 個束團位置，約佔 2700 的 3.3%。若 SASE2 分得 1000 發，SASE1/3 剩 2700 − 1000 − 90 = 1610 發。14 GeV 時 SASE1 在 K = 2.5 給 11.3 keV，同一批電子進 SASE3 若要 1.0 keV，需 K ≈ 7.3（λu = 68 mm）。~Assume a 20 µs switching gap (teaching assumption): each switch loses 20 µs / 222 ns ≈ 90 bunch slots, 3.3% of 2700. If SASE2 receives 1000 bunches, SASE1/3 keep 2700 − 1000 − 90 = 1610. At 14 GeV, SASE1 at K = 2.5 gives 11.3 keV, and for the same electrons to give 1.0 keV in SASE3 needs K ≈ 7.3 (λu = 68 mm).
units.verify: 以束團模式表與各光束線逐脈衝的 X 光氣體監測器資料交叉比對，確認每條光束線收到的束團數與時序符合要求；在切換點附近檢查第一個與最後一個束團的軌跡與能量，確認踢磁鐵上升沿與平頂起伏沒有讓邊緣束團偏離波盪器軸線。~Cross-check the bunch-pattern table against pulse-resolved X-ray gas monitor data of each beamline to confirm bunch counts and timing; near each switching point inspect the orbit and energy of the first and last bunch to make sure that kicker rise and flat-top ripple do not push edge bunches off the undulator axis.
units.failure: 平頂踢磁鐵若有 0.1% 的漣波，分到 SASE2 的束團在波盪器中出現逐發軌跡抖動，脈衝能量隨束團序號週期性起伏；使用者若沒有記錄束團模式，容易把它誤認為樣品響應。~A 0.1% ripple on the flat-top kicker gives SASE2 bunches shot-to-shot orbit jitter in the undulator and a pulse energy that oscillates with bunch index; users who do not record the bunch pattern easily mistake it for a sample response.
units.misconception: 三條 SASE 光束線各有自己的加速器，運轉參數彼此完全獨立。~The three SASE beamlines each have their own accelerator, so their parameters are fully independent.

units.anchor: 束流損失監測與捕集器~Beam-loss monitors and dumps
units.title: 機器保護、束流功率與營運交接~Machine protection, beam power and operational handoff
units.mechanism: 在 17.5 GeV、每秒 27,000 個束團下，電子束平均功率可達百 kW 級以上，一整列打到真空管或波盪器磁鐵都可能造成損傷，或讓 NdFeB 永久磁鐵受輻射去磁。機器保護系統以束流損失監測器、軌跡與入出口電荷差在脈衝列內即時判斷，在微秒級時間內停止後續束團；波盪器旁的劑量計長期追蹤累積輻射。X 光側也要限制每列的總能量，避免反射鏡與樣品前光學元件被熱負載或燒蝕破壞。交接時要把能量、電荷、列長、波盪器設定、偵測器模式與保護門檻一起記錄。~At 17.5 GeV and 27,000 bunches per second the average electron-beam power reaches the hundred-kilowatt class, and a whole train hitting the vacuum pipe or undulator magnets can cause damage or radiation-induced demagnetisation of the NdFeB magnets. Machine protection judges beam-loss monitors, orbit and the charge difference between entrance and exit within the train and stops the following bunches within microseconds, while dosimeters beside the undulators track accumulated radiation. On the X-ray side the energy per train must also be limited so that mirrors and optics in front of the sample are not destroyed by heat or ablation. The handoff records energy, charge, train length, undulator settings, detector mode and protection thresholds together.
units.model: 束流平均功率 P = E·q·f：E = 17.5 GeV、q = 0.25 nC、27,000 束團/s 時 P ≈ 17.5×10⁹ V × 0.25×10⁻⁹ C × 27,000 s⁻¹ ≈ 118 kW，q = 1 nC 時約 473 kW；每列電子能量約 11.8 kJ。X 光每發 2 mJ 在 12.4 keV 約 1.0×10¹² 光子，2700 發在 0.6 ms 內傳送 5.4 J，列內瞬時功率約 9 kW。~Average beam power is P = E·q·f: for E = 17.5 GeV, q = 0.25 nC and 27,000 bunches/s, P ≈ 17.5×10⁹ V × 0.25×10⁻⁹ C × 27,000 s⁻¹ ≈ 118 kW, and about 473 kW at 1 nC; each train carries about 11.8 kJ. At 2 mJ per X-ray pulse, 12.4 keV gives about 1.0×10¹² photons, and 2700 pulses deliver 5.4 J in 0.6 ms, about 9 kW during the train.
units.verify: 驗收時以低電荷單束團做受控損失測試，確認損失監測器在預期時間內觸發並中止後續束團；比對入出口電荷監測器在正常運轉時的差值低於門檻；定期讀取波盪器劑量計並以 K 值追蹤確認沒有去磁；為每條光束線列出最大列能量下各光學元件的熱負載評估。~During acceptance perform controlled-loss tests with a single low-charge bunch and confirm that the loss monitors trip and stop the following bunches within the expected time; check that the entrance-to-exit charge difference stays below threshold in normal running; read undulator dosimeters periodically and track K to confirm no demagnetisation; and list the heat-load assessment of every optical element at the maximum train energy for each beamline.
units.failure: 若保護系統只在列與列之間判斷而無法在列內中止，一次軌跡錯誤會讓整列約 12 kJ 的電子能量集中在同一點，熔穿真空管或讓一段波盪器去磁，造成數週停機與重新磁量測。~If protection only acts between trains and cannot stop a train in progress, a single orbit error dumps about 12 kJ of electron energy into one spot, which can puncture the vacuum pipe or demagnetise an undulator segment and cause weeks of downtime and remeasurement.
units.misconception: 超導加速器的平均束流很小，所以不需要快速機器保護。~A superconducting linac has small average current, so fast machine protection is unnecessary.

example: 操作點練習：使用者要求 SASE1 在 9.0 keV，電子能量 14 GeV（γ ≈ 27,397），λu = 40 mm。λ = 1.2398/9.0 ≈ 0.1378 nm；1 + K²/2 = λ·2γ²/λu ≈ 5.17，所以 K ≈ 2.89，對應峰值磁場 B = K/(0.934×4) ≈ 0.77 T。段間 1.1 m 漂移的落後量為 1.1/(0.040×5.17) ≈ 5.32λ，移相器需補約 0.68λ ≈ 0.094 nm。若電子能量抖動 0.05%，光子能量抖動約 0.1%，即 9 eV。AGIPD 若以每 4 個束團取 1 發（約 889 ns、1.125 MHz）記錄，352 個記憶格涵蓋 352 × 0.889 µs ≈ 313 µs，大約是 600 µs 脈衝列的一半。數值為教學假設，不代表設施的實際設定。~Operating-point exercise: a user asks for 9.0 keV from SASE1 at 14 GeV (γ ≈ 27,397) with λu = 40 mm. λ = 1.2398/9.0 ≈ 0.1378 nm; 1 + K²/2 = λ·2γ²/λu ≈ 5.17, so K ≈ 2.89, a peak field B = K/(0.934×4) ≈ 0.77 T. The 1.1 m intersection drift slips 1.1/(0.040×5.17) ≈ 5.32λ, so the phase shifter adds about 0.68λ ≈ 0.094 nm. An electron-energy jitter of 0.05% becomes about 0.1% photon-energy jitter, 9 eV. If AGIPD records every fourth bunch (about 889 ns, 1.125 MHz), its 352 memory cells span 352 × 0.889 µs ≈ 313 µs, roughly half of the 600 µs train. Values are teaching assumptions, not the facility's actual settings.
history: European XFEL 建立在 DESY 主導的 TESLA 超導加速技術與漢堡 FLASH 自由電子雷射的經驗上，FLASH 驗證了以超導直線加速器驅動的 SASE 在軟 X 光波段可行。European XFEL GmbH 於 2009 年成立並開始土建，3.4 km 的隧道設施於 2017 年首次產生雷射並開放使用者實驗；之後持續擴充實驗站與 MHz 偵測器。本課只重建公開原理與設施公開資料，不涉及任何操作程序。~European XFEL builds on the TESLA superconducting-acceleration technology led by DESY and on the FLASH free-electron laser in Hamburg, which proved that SASE driven by a superconducting linac works in the soft X-ray range. European XFEL GmbH was founded in 2009 and civil construction began; the 3.4 km tunnel facility first lased in 2017 and opened to user experiments the same year, after which instruments and MHz detectors kept expanding. This course reconstructs only public principles and published facility data, not any operating procedure.
